name: AirPods 4 Pro Clone
subtitle: White fourth-generation style wireless earbuds
description: AirPods 4 Pro Clone are white true wireless earbuds with Bluetooth 5.3 connectivity, touch controls and a USB-C charging case. They support Android, iOS, tablets and laptops, with an in-ear stem design, integrated call microphone and up to 20 hours total backup with the case.
story: These fourth-generation style wireless earbuds are designed for everyday listening, calls and portable use. Bluetooth 5.3 provides the listed wireless connection, while the compact charging case uses USB-C for recharging. Touch controls allow music and call management directly from the earbuds, and mono mode lets a single earbud be used when supported. The white stem-style design is paired with an in-ear fit, making the set suitable for use with compatible Android and iOS devices, tablets and laptops.
shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
